newsHighlights.title: COP31 fails to reach consensus on Antalya Pact
newsHighlights.summary: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference failed to reach consensus on the proposed Antalya Pact, COP31 President Murat Kurum said on Sunday.
newsHighlights.translation: 《联合国气候变化框架公约》第三十一次缔约方会议（COP31）主席库鲁姆周日表示，会议未能就拟议中的《安塔利亚协定》达成共识。

newsHighlights.title: Where does the APEC venue get its power?
newsHighlights.summary: The APEC venue runs largely on renewable energy, showcasing how major international events can cut carbon emissions.
newsHighlights.translation: 亚太经合组织会议场馆主要由可再生能源供电，展示了重大国际活动如何减少碳排放。

newsHighlights.title: Xi calls for inclusive regional co-op based on solidarity, openness, innovation
newsHighlights.summary: China called for inclusive regional cooperation grounded in solidarity, openness and innovation to advance shared prosperity in the Asia-Pacific.
newsHighlights.translation: 中方倡导在团结、开放、创新基础上开展包容性区域合作，推动亚太共同繁荣。

newsHighlights.title: China-built cruise ship embarks on maiden voyage with over 3,800 guests
newsHighlights.summary: The Adora Flora City, China's second domestically built large cruise ship, started its maiden commercial voyage, marking a step toward greener large-scale shipbuilding.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国第二艘国产大型邮轮“爱达·花城号”开启商业首航，标志着中国在绿色大型船舶建造方面迈出一步。

newsHighlights.title: Global experts discuss community with a shared future for humanity
newsHighlights.summary: Global experts discussed building a community with a shared future for humanity, stressing green development and global governance reform.
newsHighlights.translation: 全球专家探讨构建人类命运共同体，强调绿色发展与全球治理改革。

quote.quote: The Earth is what we all have in common.
quote.author: Wendell Berry
quote.translation: 地球是我们所有人的共同家园。
quote.explanation: 美国作家温德尔·贝瑞提醒我们：无论国籍、文化或立场如何不同，人类共享同一个地球。这与今日新闻中COP31气候谈判的艰难进程相呼应——气候变化是全球性挑战，唯有共识与合作才能守护共同的家园。

vocabulary.example: COP31 failed to reach consensus on the proposed Antalya Pact after days of intense negotiation.
vocabulary.translation: 经过数日激烈谈判，COP31未能就拟议中的《安塔利亚协定》达成共识。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题“COP31 fails to reach consensus on Antalya Pact”。

vocabulary.example: The proposed Antalya Pact aimed to set new targets for cutting global carbon emissions.
vocabulary.translation: 拟议中的《安塔利亚协定》旨在为削减全球碳排放设定新目标。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“COP31 fails to reach consensus on Antalya Pact”，指会议讨论的气候协定草案。

vocabulary.example: The APEC venue gets most of its power from renewable energy sources such as solar and wind.
vocabulary.translation: 亚太经合组织会议场馆的电力大部分来自太阳能、风能等可再生能源。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“Where does the APEC venue get its power?”，描述场馆的清洁能源供电方案。

vocabulary.definition: 排放；散发（尤指气体、热量）
vocabulary.example: Using clean electricity at the venue helped reduce carbon emissions during the summit.
vocabulary.translation: 会场使用清洁电力，有助于减少峰会期间的碳排放。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自“APEC venue”相关新闻，谈及重大会议的减碳举措。

vocabulary.example: Leaders called for inclusive regional cooperation to build a more sustainable future for the Asia-Pacific.
vocabulary.translation: 各国领导人呼吁开展包容性区域合作，为亚太地区构建更可持续的未来。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻“Xi calls for inclusive regional co-op”，可持续发展是会议核心议题。

vocabulary.example: The energy transition is essential if the world wants to limit global warming.
vocabulary.translation: 若想限制全球变暖，能源转型至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自COP31气候大会报道，指各国讨论的能源与经济低碳转型。

vocabulary.example: Reaching a global pact requires a stronger commitment from both developed and developing countries.
vocabulary.translation: 达成全球协定需要发达国家和发展中国家作出更坚定的承诺。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自COP31相关报道，指各国在减排问题上的承诺力度。

vocabulary.example: China called for regional cooperation based on solidarity, openness and innovation.
vocabulary.translation: 中方倡导在团结、开放、创新的基础上开展区域合作。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“Xi calls for inclusive regional co-op based on solidarity, openness, innovation”。

vocabulary.example: Inclusive green growth ensures that no country is left behind in the fight against climate change.
vocabulary.translation: 包容性绿色发展确保在应对气候变化的行动中没有国家掉队。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“Xi calls for inclusive regional co-op”，强调合作的包容性。

vocabulary.definition: 登上（船、飞机等）；着手，开始
vocabulary.example: The Adora Flora City embarked on its maiden commercial voyage with more than 3,800 guests on Sunday.
vocabulary.translation: “爱达·花城号”周日搭载3800多名乘客开启了商业首航。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“China-built cruise ship embarks on maiden voyage”，也常用于 embark on a journey/plan（着手进行）。

pattern.pattern: mark a significant step toward (doing) sth —— 标志着朝……迈出的重要一步
pattern.example: The maiden voyage of the Adora Flora City marked a significant step toward the large-scale, green development of China's cruise shipbuilding industry.
pattern.translation: “爱达·花城号”的首航标志着中国邮轮制造业向规模化、绿色发展迈出了重要一步。
pattern.usage: mark 在此意为“标志着”，step toward 后接名词或动名词，常用于新闻报道和写作中描述进展。类似表达还有：mark a milestone in...（标志着……的里程碑）、represent a major leap forward（代表重大飞跃）。

grammar.title: 现在分词作结果状语（Present Participle as a Result Adverbial）
grammar.explanation: 当句子前半部分描述一个动作或情况，后半部分用“动词-ing”形式表示该动作自然导致的结果时，就构成了现在分词作结果状语。它相当于 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，语气更简洁，是英语新闻中的高频结构。注意：现在分词的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致；若表示“意外结果”，常用 only + doing。
examples: The Adora Flora City embarked on its maiden commercial voyage with more than 3,800 guests on Sunday, marking a significant step toward large-scale cruise shipbuilding.
COP31 failed to reach consensus on the Antalya Pact, leaving the future of the global climate agenda uncertain.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈsteɪ/ 上，首音节弱读为 /sə/（schwa 音）。发音顺序为 suh-STAY-nuh-buhl，注意 /eɪ/ 是双元音，要饱满滑动，结尾的 -able 读作 /əbl/，不要读成“爱博”。常与 sustainable development（可持续发展）连用。
examples: Sustainable development has become a central topic at the UN climate conference.
The APEC venue's use of renewable energy shows a commitment to sustainable practices.

reading.title: Climate Talks Stall, but Green Momentum Continues
reading.content: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) ended in Antalya without consensus on the proposed Antalya Pact, reminding the world that global climate cooperation remains difficult. Yet progress outside the negotiating rooms is visible. The APEC venue, for example, runs largely on renewable energy, cutting carbon emissions and showing how major international events can be greener. China has also called for inclusive regional cooperation based on solidarity, openness and innovation, arguing that green development and economic growth can go hand in hand. Meanwhile, the launch of the Adora Flora City, a domestically built cruise ship, marked a significant step toward cleaner, large-scale shipbuilding. Experts say that even without a final pact, the energy transition is already under way. Reaching consensus takes time, but every solar panel installed and every clean technology adopted brings the world closer to a sustainable future.
reading.translation: 第31届联合国气候变化大会（COP31）在安塔利亚落幕，未能就拟议中的《安塔利亚协定》达成共识，这提醒世人：全球气候合作依然艰难。然而谈判会场之外的进展清晰可见。例如，亚太经合组织会议场馆主要依靠可再生能源供电，减少了碳排放，展示了重大国际活动可以更加绿色。中方也倡导在团结、开放、创新的基础上开展包容性区域合作，主张绿色发展与经济增长可以并行不悖。与此同时，国产大型邮轮“爱达·花城号”的启航，标志着中国在更清洁的规模化造船方面迈出重要一步。专家表示，即便没有最终协定，能源转型已经在进行之中。达成共识需要时间，但每安装一块太阳能电池板、每采用一项清洁技术，都让世界离可持续的未来更近一步。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于2026年11月23日 ChinaDaily 与 CGTN 真实新闻改写：①COP31 fails to reach consensus on Antalya Pact；②Where does the APEC venue get its power?；③Xi calls for inclusive regional co-op；④China-built cruise ship embarks on maiden voyage；⑤Global experts discuss community with a shared future for humanity。
